key.name: layout
key.summary: Keyboard layout (qwertz = German, qwerty = US)

key.name: layout-style
key.summary: Key arrangement: classic (ThinkPad-like, 5–6 rows) or touch (4 rows, symbol/number layer, emoji, long-press accents; inspired by the Windows 11 touch keyboard)

key.name: auto-capitalize
key.summary: Touch style: start sentences (after . ! ? and Enter) with a capital letter

key.name: recent-emoji
key.summary: Internal: recently used emoji (touch style emoji panel)

key.name: show-f-row
key.summary: Show the separate function-key row (false = compact, F-keys via Fn on the number row)

key.name: key-height-mm
key.summary: Physical key height in millimetres

key.name: shrink-workarea
key.summary: Reserve screen space (strut) while visible so windows shrink instead of being covered

key.name: auto-show
key.summary: Show automatically when a text field gets focus

key.name: hide-after-submit
key.summary: After Enter in a single-line field (form/message sent) or Esc, hide an auto-shown keyboard

key.name: move-dock-left
key.summary: While the docked keyboard is visible, move a bottom Ubuntu Dock to the left edge

key.name: dock-saved-position
key.summary: Internal: original dock position to restore ('' = nothing to restore)

key.name: ignore-physical-keyboard
key.summary: Testing: auto-show even while an external keyboard is connected

key.name: show-panel-icon
key.summary: Show the toggle icon in the top bar

key.name: swipe-gestures
key.summary: Enable swipe up from the bottom edge / swipe down on the handle

key.name: fallback-dpi
key.summary: Pixels per inch used when the monitor's physical size is unknown

key.name: mode
key.summary: docked = full width at the bottom (may shrink work area); floating = movable, resizable panel

key.name: keyboard-position
key.summary: Docked and thumb mode: keyboard at the bottom or at the top edge (below the top bar)

key.name: docked-width
key.summary: Width of the docked keyboard as a fraction of the screen width (0.5–1.0, centred; narrower keys)

key.name: floating-opacity
key.summary: Opacity of the keyboard in floating mode (0.3–1.0)

key.name: suggestion-bar-position
key.summary: Suggestion bar above (top) or below (bottom) the keys

key.name: thumb-key-height-mm
key.summary: Key height in thumb mode (split keyboard), in mm

key.name: keep-key-aspect
key.summary: Below 13 mm key height keep the key proportions (narrower keyboard) instead of flatter keys

key.name: label-brightness
key.summary: Brightness of the key labels (0.65–1.0; 1.0 = near white)

key.name: press-flash-ms
key.summary: Pressed keys flash brightly and fade out over this many ms (0 = off)

key.name: letter-case
key.summary: Letter key labels: always upper case, or lower case unless Shift/Caps is active

key.name: key-glow
key.summary: Strength of the glowing rim around the keys (0 = off, 1 = strongest)

key.name: key-glow-width
key.summary: Width of the glow around the keys in px (capped at half the key gap)

key.name: floating-x
key.summary: Floating panel x position (logical px, -1 = centred)

key.name: floating-y
key.summary: Floating panel y position (logical px, -1 = bottom)

key.name: floating-width
key.summary: Floating panel width in logical px (-1 = 70% of monitor width); keys scale with it

key.name: suggestions
key.summary: Show word suggestions in the suggestion bar

key.name: autocorrect
key.summary: Correct the current word automatically on space/punctuation (BackSpace right after reverts)

key.name: dynamic-hitareas
key.summary: Enlarge the touch area of likely next letters (invisible, iOS-like)

key.name: prediction-language
key.summary: Prediction language (auto: QWERTZ = German, QWERTY = English)

key.name: clear-userdict-request
key.summary: Incremented to request clearing the learned user dictionary (value itself is meaningless)

key.name: super-symbol
key.summary: Label of the Super key: fish, diamond or the text "Super"

key.name: modifier-hold-release
key.summary: A modifier held down acts while held and is released on key-up after modifier-hold-ms

key.name: modifier-hold-ms
key.summary: Hold duration in ms after which a held modifier is released on key-up
